description: Search messages across the Slack workspace

include_rich_message_fields.description: Include Slack message attachments, blocks, metadata, files, and reactions when present

provenance.description: Author labelling for returned messages. label (default) stamps origin and author_trusted on every message; strict also holds slack_send_message after outside-authored text has been read. Defaults to SLACK_MCP_PROVENANCE, else label. This argument can only tighten labelling, never loosen it: to drop the labels entirely and get the pre-5.1 output shape, set SLACK_MCP_PROVENANCE=off on the server.

query.description: Search query (supports Slack syntax like from:@user, in:#channel)

name: slack_search_messages
